---
title: "Detail page template"
description: "A detail page: breadcrumbs, a back link and a title, the content, and a sticky aside card with the facts about the item."
---

A template renders `PageLayout`, fixes part of it, and exposes props for the rest. It is copy-code: the file is yours to edit.

## Preview

**Anatomy** colours the fixed parts, the props, and the scroll region. The panel changes the props live; the fixed parts stay.

<LayoutPreview slug="templates/detail-page/default" kind="template" controls={"[{\"name\":\"title\",\"label\":\"Title\",\"type\":\"text\",\"value\":\"Order 1042\"},{\"name\":\"aside\",\"label\":\"Show aside\",\"type\":\"boolean\",\"value\":true}]"} codeFiles="../../templates/detail-page/detail-page-template.tsx,examples/templates/detail-page/default.tsx" />

## Fixed and variable

**Fixed by the template** (edit the constants at the top of the file):

- Header layout with breadcrumbs and back link
- Aside card frame

**Props** (the variable part):

- `title`, `breadcrumbs`, `backHref`, `actions`
- `children`
- `aside`: the facts in the card

## Install

<RegistryCommand name="detail-page-template" />

## Code

The template is one file, and a page uses it. The page sets only what varies: no heights, no overflow.
